app.title: MiniLake Is a Local Databricks API Emulator with SQL, Delta Lake and Spark
app.author: kermatt
app.description: A lightweight emulator for Databricks Runtime, exposing REST APIs for SQL, Delta Lake, and Spark.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and install dependencies with pip.
Run `minilake serve` and verify the HTTP server starts on port 8080.
Execute a simple SQL query via the REST API and assert the returned result set.
Create a Delta Lake table, write data, and read it back to confirm correctness.
